$description: WizKlub Design System tokens (W3C DTCG format). Use SEMANTIC tokens (color.*); primitives are for aliasing only. Code truth: frontend/wizklub-testimonials/src/styles/tokens.css. Figma: WizKlub Design System (ALYUYxBSYECsXW1jI0TPOC).

primitive.$description: Raw brand values. Hidden in Figma. Do not use directly in UI.

500.$description: Tangerine: primary CTA fill, progress, active fills. Text on it is NAVY.

band.$description: App chrome band (desktop frame, login brand half).

frame.$description: Deeper chrome behind white menu text (3.31:1, bold/large only).

dome.$description: Lighter dome rising from the bottom of the chrome.

edge.$description: 3px chunky bottom edge under primary buttons.

900.$description: Logo navy: ALL main text, text on orange (5.6:1).

color.$description: Semantic colours. The ONLY colours UI should use.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, desktop content panel, inputs.

surface-muted.$description: Stat tiles inside cards, disabled button fill.

surface-hover.$description: Hover on rows and secondary buttons.

chrome.$description: Desktop chrome + login brand half; pair with bg/chrome-dome.

chrome-frame.$description: Desktop frame/menu where WHITE menu labels sit.

chrome-dome.$description: Dome ellipse (150% x 88% at 50% 100%) over bg/chrome.

brand-soft.$description: Peach soft fill: avatar, icon tiles, active bottom-nav item.

primary.$description: Primary button fill. Label MUST be text/on-brand (navy).

secondary-border.$description: Secondary button border; also Selected chip fill.

primary.$description: Headings and body. Navy, never black.

on-brand.$description: Text/icons ON orange. Never white on bright orange.

on-dark.$description: Text on navy promo and white menu labels on bg/chrome-frame.

default.$description: Borders when needed (cards use Shadow/md instead).

light.$description: Hairline dividers, top bar bottom border.

green-fg.$description: Health Green (G) text + dot. Bands = counts of students, never averages.

pill.$description: Everything you tap: buttons, chips, tabs, badges, nav items.

large.$description: Code: lead paragraphs, mobile form values

default.$description: Code: labels, chip labels, list titles

md.$description: DEFAULT for every card (cards have no border).

brand-edge.$description: 3px orange edge under PRIMARY buttons only.
